name: What are common home modifications for seniors with limited mobility?

mainEntity.name: What are common home modifications for seniors with limited mobility?

acceptedAnswer.text: For seniors with limited mobility, common home modifications include installing ramps at entryways or stairlifts for multi-story homes. Inside, widening doorways and hallways ensures wheelchair or walker access. Bathrooms often benefit from roll-in showers with seating, grab bars, and raised toilet seats. In kitchens, lowering countertops and creating pull-out shelving can improve accessibility. These changes aim to reduce physical strain and prevent falls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications for seniors with limited mobility include ramps, stairlifts, wider doorways, roll-in showers, grab bars, and accessible kitchen features to improve safety and ease of movement.
